prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client, who was injured in a sideswipe collision while changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. We represent our client's interests in full and ask that any correspondence, requests for statements, or settlement discussions be routed through us.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request that you disclose the liability limits of the policy under which your insured is covered, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing within a reasonable time.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, the claim file, recorded statements, and any police or witness reports in your possession. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained and not altered or discarded while this matter is pending.
